name: Schtasks Creation Or Modification With SYSTEM Privileges
description: Detects the creation or update of a scheduled task to run with "NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM" privileges
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:*\\schtasks.exe AND (process.command_line:(*\ \/change\ * OR *\ \/create\ *))) AND process.command_line:*\/ru\ * AND (process.command_line:(*NT\ AUT* OR *\ SYSTEM\ *))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:*\\schtasks.exe AND (process.command_line:*\/TN\ TVInstallRestore* AND process.command_line:*\\TeamViewer_.exe*)) OR (process.command_line:*Subscription\ Heartbeat* AND process.command_line:*\\HeartbeatConfig.xml* AND process.command_line:*\\Microsoft\ Shared\\OFFICE*) OR (process.command_line:(*\/Create\ \/F\ \/RU\ System\ \/SC\ WEEKLY\ \/TN\ AviraSystemSpeedupVerify\ \/TR\ * OR *\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Avira\\System\ Speedup\\setup\\avira_speedup_setup.exe* OR *\/VERIFY\ \/VERYSILENT\ \/NOSTART\ \/NODOTNET\ \/NORESTART\"\ \/RL\ HIGHEST*))))
